top_stories.title: 【リリース】anthropic-sdk-python v1.15.0: v1.15.0
top_stories.body:
### Features

* **api:** add between_tools to thinking types in model capabilities
* **api:** add the speed parameter and usage.speed to Messages
* **api:** return a Console organization's usage-tier spend cap as a read-only spend limit


### Chores

* **ci:** speed up breaking change detection
* **docs:** describe headers on Managed Agents and telemetry endpoints
* **internal:** simplify the script that formats code blocks in docs
* **tests:** cover OpenTelemetry options and method default timeouts


### Documentation

* **api:** note that some models need a beta header to use speed

top_stories.title: 【リリース】claude-code v2.1.301: v2.1.301
top_stories.body:
## What's changed

- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS` so unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) ends a request at a usage limit that resets too far away instead of waiting
- Added OpenTelemetry tracing guidance to the `claude-api` skill, including setting up trace destinations with the `ant` CLI
- Added the `%` motion to vim mode: jump to the matching bracket, alone or with d/c/y
- Added `rows` to a mod's `Input`: a text field of several lines in the terminal, where Enter submits and Shift+Enter or a backslash before Enter starts a new line
- Added `clas

top_stories.title: 【リリース】claude-code v2.1.300: v2.1.300
top_stories.body:
## What's changed

- Added `virtualText` to a mod's prompt decorations: text drawn in the prompt box that never enters the draft or the submitted prompt
- Added `cache_creation_5m_tokens` and `cache_creation_1h_tokens` to the OpenTelemetry `api_request` event, splitting cache writes by lifetime
- Added `$.ui.view({ agentId })` for mods: shows an agent's transcript in the main view when you ask, and `$.ui.view({})` goes back
- Added a `dir` prop on a mod's `Text` for right-to-left text: on Windows and in VS Code's terminal its rows read in that direction and sit flush right
- Added `/advisor` o

top_stories.title: 【リリース】anthropic-sdk-typescript google-cloud-sdk-v0.1.0: google-cloud-sdk-v0.1.0
top_stories.body:
### Features

* **api:** add execution_identity to Managed Agents agents
* **client:** add native support for OpenTelemetry tracing

  If your app registers a global tracer provider, the SDK will create spans with it after upgrading, and they'll be exported with the rest of your traces. Requests will also get trace context headers from the global propagator. To disable, pass `openTelemetry: false` to the client or set `ANTHROPIC_OPEN_TELEMETRY=false`. Learn more in the [documentation](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/opentelemetry/sdk).


### Chores

* include the license file
